name: Moble Benedict
title: Professor; Chancellor EDGES Fellow; AVFL director
department: Aerospace Engineering; Advanced Vertical Flight Laboratory
researchAreas: Reinforcement learning for physical flight control
fitReason: Verified recent learned controller on actual aircraft, with substantive reinforcement-learning/control contributions.

physicalEvidence.summary: The complete May 2026 primary manuscript verifies actual Crazyflie 2.X flights. An IsaacLab-trained recurrent PPO outer loop runs offboard, assisted by a GRU residual-dynamics predictor estimating external forces/moments from state and motor-command history; onboard PID stabilizes rate commands. Onboard EKF/IMU/Flow Deck replaces external motion capture. A small real-flight calibration set and an online thrust-bias accumulator address transfer offsets. Physical tests cover central and asymmetric payloads and figure-eight flight with a suspended load. This is learned inference/adaptation in a real flight loop, not only simulation or online policy-weight training. The domain-randomized baseline was not flown under heavier payloads after unsafe oscillations, so comparisons are not complete across every condition. Turbulent ship wakes, larger aircraft and other airframes remain future work. Lead author Saj is independently listed in Benedict’s lab and the March 2026 university student-team report, supporting directed current-lab attribution and physical25.
